request.note: No payload. The handler reads no field.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: You have a character and you are alive. No item changes: the item test starts with `0 &&`. There is no `game_response`.

confirm.note: The loop test starts with `0 &&`, so no item changes; `"reopen"` adds `reopen: true` and does not bump `cid`

rows.when: No character, or you are dead (`player.rip`).
